d: Jet black, wavy hair with long bangs partially covering the forehead. Sharp, narrow eyes in a deep brown shade, set in a mature face appearing to be in the late twenties or early thirties. A lean, athletic build wearing a burnt orange overcoat draped over the shoulders, a deep purple vest over a white V-neck shirt with a white neck-tie, and dark purple trousers with black side stripes and buckled straps on the left thigh. Accessories include a silver metallic prosthetic right hand and forearm, a silver belt buckle, and a black rectangular sign held in the left hand.
